reviews.review: This game is very good for people who have much time to play PC games. It's very long, because his long missions and farming system but the graphics are very good, very good optimization. I like very much games like taht one because you don't have to pvp (Warframe is a PVM game) and it's not competitive. There are missions that can be annoying but it's okay. It's a chill game that you can play in tour free time, you can play with your friends and make missions together. It's very fun to grind with your friends for resources and build warframes and guns, swords ETC. to be more powerful.

The game itself is really fun. Whether you play with friends or explore the galaxy solo, there's something for everyone. Unfortunately, there's a few bugs and actual in game coding that causes a lot of migraines. Climbing is a pain and when escorting captured allies during missions they never follow your exact movements and will always stop to fight enemies. During syndicate defense missions, as well as during escort captured missions, AI have the worst programming ever. It's honestly a miracle they never miss a shot. Hopefully these bugs and mechanics get fixed.
Very fun game, If you got friends to play with this game turns into a 10/10 game. Nothing like Devouring everything you see as space ninja
